review_scope: coherence and impact of one actual external Scope Unit Declaration, one or more external Goals, internal Tier-0 Scope Contract Atoms, and eventual project_structure.toml authority retirement

actual_conflicts.finding: Do not reuse the generic CORE_META_MODEL Declaration as the Project's actual declaration. It declares the Scope Unit kind and containment model, not an instance declaration for each real unit.
actual_conflicts.required_boundary: Create exactly one separate external declaration for the actual Project Scope Unit; retain the generic kind declaration without copying generic semantics into the instance.

actual_conflicts.finding: The prior Scope Definition/Goal-replacement trial is superseded. A per-unit Scope Definition would duplicate the rejected Definition layer and conflict with separate external Goals.
actual_conflicts.required_boundary: Use the actual Declaration plus its Contracts; keep one or more Goals as separate Atoms and link them rather than copying Goal content into the Declaration.

actual_conflicts.finding: Project-root external ownership and physical carrier location are not decided. 'External' is relative to the governed Scope Unit; it does not itself select an owner, folder, or Operator-owned declaration.
actual_conflicts.question: Who owns the Project Declaration, and in which authoritative carrier is it stored, given that the Project has no parent Scope Unit and the Operator Actor is not a Scope Unit?
actual_conflicts.safe_draft_position: State the Declaration is external to the Project and leave its owner/location unresolved; do not assert Operator ownership.

actual_conflicts.finding: A Declaration may cover ID, Name, ordered/unordered, Label, Navigation Number, and connections, but no mandatory per-field cardinality, format, or derivation rule was authorized. The generic drafts currently contain per-property cardinality syntax and structural-level derivation, so they cannot be silently treated as the actual-instance schema.
actual_conflicts.required_boundary: Keep the instance declaration descriptive of the selected Project facts; do not import or create new mandatory field/cardinality/derivation rules.

actual_conflicts.finding: Internal foundation is plural and RMEDO-as-applicable, not one R and not all five Roles. Treating Contracts as a single Definition or demanding a full five-Role set would contradict both the latest direction and A1313.
actual_conflicts.required_boundary: Specify zero or more applicable Tier-0 Contract Atoms per admitted RMEDO role, independently of the separate external Goal count.

cutover_dependencies.finding: project_structure.toml is currently labeled authoritative and contains the live per-unit structural records (parent, type, label, navigation/order, authority and delivery paths). A future replacement therefore needs an explicit source-of-truth cutover, not two independently maintained authorities.
cutover_dependencies.required_boundary: Draft-only work must make no TOML change. The adoption packet must name the new governing declaration set, the derivation/compatibility relationship, the cutover instant, and retirement of TOML as governing authority.

cutover_dependencies.finding: The new actual Project Declaration alone cannot replace every current TOML record. The file lists many non-Project Scope Units and includes fields beyond the currently decided declaration examples, so a one-instance Draft can establish no project-wide TOML retirement by itself.
cutover_dependencies.question: Is the intended future cutover limited to the Project record first, or does it require a complete declared replacement inventory before TOML loses governing status?
cutover_dependencies.safe_draft_position: Do not claim TOML retirement or derived compatibility until the replacement inventory and consumer migration are explicit.

cutover_dependencies.finding: Ordering has two live TOML representations: scope_unit_type plus local_order/navigational_order_number. Latest input permits ordered/unordered and navigation number but decides no format/derivation rules; it does not resolve their relationship or sibling-order source of truth.
cutover_dependencies.question: For ordered Scope Units, which declaration fact governs sibling order: navigation number, local order, both, or a later relation?
cutover_dependencies.safe_draft_position: Record existing observed values without declaring equivalence, derivation, or a new ordering grammar.

non_conflicts: Separate external Goals are coherent with A1313 when their target is the governed Project and their content is not duplicated in the Declaration.
A Project Goal may remain Operator-owned and Tier -1; this does not establish ownership of the Project Declaration.
The generic declaration's Project root model supports a root with no containment parent, but it is Draft-only and does not decide physical carrier location or adoption.
scope_guardrails: No Current methodology, project_structure.toml, code/runtime, projections, promotion, or automatic declaration synthesis is authorized in this Draft task.
No new GFEL syntax, functions, relation names, control/status machinery, or per-field rules should be introduced to resolve these gaps.
